zh: 罗蒙诺索夫莫斯科国立大学（Lomonosov Moscow State University，简称 MSU）成立于1755年，是俄罗斯最古老、规模最大的大学，也是欧洲最大的大学之一。学校由著名科学家米哈伊尔·罗蒙诺索夫倡议创办，以其在自然科学、人文科学和社会科学领域的卓越研究而闻名于世。作为俄罗斯高等教育的旗舰，MSU培养了大量杰出人才，包括多位诺贝尔奖得主。
en: Lomonosov Moscow State University (MSU) was founded in 1755

contact: making it Russia's oldest and largest university and one of the largest in Europe. The university was established on the initiative of the famous scientist Mikhail Lomonosov and is renowned worldwide for its卓越 research in natural sciences

address.en: and social sciences. As the flagship of Russian higher education
